title: Spyglass: Now Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing powerful new capabilities and insights to all users.

title: Next-Level File Management in Your Editor
summary: Gain complete control over your content with new powerful tools to manage, upload, and customize how files appear directly within the editor.

title: Interactive Public Roadmap
summary: Stay informed about our latest progress and future plans with our brand-new, interactive public roadmap, now live on our website.

title: Smarter, Smoother Checkboxes
summary: Experience improved task management with our enhanced checkboxes that are now easier to click, drag, and visually align perfectly with our updated design.

title: Real-Time Collaboration Enhancements
summary: We've significantly upgraded our editor to make collaborating with your team smoother, more intuitive, and highly efficient.

title: Elevated Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on all ideas and quests shared with you, empowering seamless teamwork and collective achievement.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: We're thrilled to introduce support for a variety of international languages, enabling more users around the world to enjoy Noeko in their preferred language.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now proudly open source, offering our community maximum control and the opportunity to directly contribute to its exciting evolution.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Your Constellation View
summary: We're transforming your Constellation view with powerful new filtering capabilities and seamless workflow integrations, empowering you to explore your knowledge, discover connections, and initiate tasks with greater efficiency.

title: Precision Search & Saved Views
summary: Effortlessly refine your search results with powerful new tag and time-based filters, then save these curated collections for instant future reference.

title: Richer Content Linking for Seamless Organization
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts and insights with dynamic content previews and enhanced interactivity for linked information.

title: Noeko: Your Data, Your Control with Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Experience unparalleled control and flexibility as we introduce Noeko's self-hosting capabilities and a range of new paid plans designed to empower individuals and teams.

title: Stunning New Themes and Refined Classics
summary: Get ready to personalize your experience with beautifully revamped themes and an exciting collection of brand-new aesthetic options designed to delight every user.

title: More Personalized Greetings
summary: We're refining our app to ensure greetings always accurately reflect the time of day, enhancing your personalized experience.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Experience a new level of efficiency as you effortlessly manage and organize your tagged items with powerful new actions available directly from the tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate content from YouTube videos, websites, and text files to expand your knowledge base and enrich your note-taking experience.
